name: kings-coding-machine-v1
description: Gateway-first governed AI coding machine with real build/test verification

scripts.build:owner-ui: tsc --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --moduleResolution Node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict --types node --outDir .kings-ui-build ui/project-owner/local-server.ts
scripts.check: npm run build:owner-ui && npm run test:workforce
scripts.check:live: npm run build:owner-ui && npm run test:workforce:live
scripts.verify:production:live: npm run check && npm run preflight:production && npm run check:gateway-live
scripts.start:production: npm run preflight:production && npm run start:owner-ui
